# ChunkC

> **Kind:** component · **Registry:** host · **Folder:** [`src/logic/terrain/`](../folders/src-logic-terrain.md)
> **Source:** [`src/logic/terrain/chunk.h`](../../../src/logic/terrain/chunk.h)

## Summary

A marching cubes chunk at integer chunk coordinates.

## Description

Created by ChunkManagerSys on a new entity (and registered in ChunkMap) for every chunk whose centre is within view_distance of a load centre. A chunk covers chunk::length = 256 world units per side (64 cubes of 4 units); origin() = pos * 256, center() = origin + 128. TerrainSys destroys the entity once it is tagged ChunkDestroying and not ChunkGenerating.
